summary: Tested Admin Portal + Ecommerce integration. 15/15 backend tests pass covering admin auth, stats, orders list/search/filter, pricing CRUD with persistence, delivery fees CRUD, Stripe checkout session creation, and order→admin visibility. Frontend admin login works; dashboard stats cards render; test order created via checkout API appears in Recent Orders. Orders and Pricing sub-nav links exist and render content.

critical.issue: Order lookups use {"_id": transaction["order_id"]} where order_id is a STRING, but Mongo _id is ObjectId. Must wrap with ObjectId(order_id). Result: after Stripe payment completes, order status stays 'pending_payment' and payment_status stays 'pending' — orders never progress to 'processing', revenue stat always $0, and confirmation emails never fire.

minor.issue: Duplicate key '78006' (Boerne and Bergheim). Harmless now since DB lookups are used, but dead/misleading code.
Exceptions from invalid ObjectId (e.g., non-24-hex order_id) bubble to generic 500 instead of 400/404.

ui_bugs.issue: 'THE DIRT PLACE ADMIN / Management Portal' text visibly overlaps with the public-site logo 'THE DIRT PLACE / Boerne, Texas' in top-left after login. Looks like the admin layout renders on top of the public Navbar instead of replacing it. See /admin/dashboard screenshot.
Public-site navbar (Home/Materials/Delivery/Contact/Cart/Request Delivery) is shown on admin pages — admin pages should have their own layout without the public shop navbar.

issues: Password hint 'Password: dirtplace2024' is printed on the login page — remove before production (security disclosure).

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix ObjectId conversion in /app/backend/routes/ecommerce.py in get_checkout_status() and stripe_webhook() — wrap transaction['order_id'] / metadata['order_id'] with ObjectId() when updating db.orders. Without this fix the entire Stripe→admin revenue/status flow is broken.
HIGH: Fix admin layout so public Navbar does not render on /admin/* routes — the overlapping logo/title in top-left is a visible bug.
Remove the hardcoded password hint from AdminLoginPage.jsx.
Remove duplicate '78006' key in DELIVERY_FEES dict in ecommerce.py.
Add ObjectId validation + proper 400/404 responses in admin order detail and status update endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: Orders written with ObjectId _id but referenced as string via transaction['order_id'] — type mismatch causes silent update failures (matched_count=0). No test catches this because tests don't actually complete Stripe payment.
ADMIN_PASSWORD is used as the bearer token itself — any leak of a single request exposes the master password. OK for MVP but flag for prod.
Admin routes depend on a global Mongo client created at import time in routes/admin.py and routes/ecommerce.py — duplicated Mongo client init across files; should be centralized.
Pricing PUT doesn't validate material_id matches the path parameter vs body.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (admin login + dashboard + integration confirmed; layout overlap bug)

rca of the issue: RCA of CRITICAL bug: In /app/backend/routes/ecommerce.py, create_checkout_session stores order_id as str(order_result.inserted_id). Later get_checkout_status() and stripe_webhook() call db.orders.update_one({'_id': transaction['order_id']}, ...) with a STRING, but Mongo _id is ObjectId → zero matches → order never transitions to 'processing'/'paid'. Fix: from bson import ObjectId; then {'_id': ObjectId(transaction['order_id'])} in both handlers. Reproduction: create checkout session, poll /api/ecommerce/checkout/status/{session_id} after Stripe simulates payment — order.status remains 'pending_payment'. Mitigation: add ObjectId wrap + a unit test that mocks StripeCheckout.get_checkout_status to return paid and asserts order status transition.
